sentence: Clean up the backyard and haul away the fallen branch.

observation.model_notes: The customer's sentence asks to "haul away the fallen branch," but no fallen or downed branch is visible in either photo. Photo 1 is a wide shot of the whole backyard (lawn, fence line, patio, beds) and Photo 2 is a closer shot of a shrub and potted plants — neither shows any loose branch, log, or brush pile on the ground. The location, size, and quantity of the branch could not be confirmed from these photos and would need to be verified on site.

supporting_evidence.note: Patio, potted plants, and shrub area in the foreground appear tidy and maintained, no loose debris or clutter visible.

evidence.note: Lawn is mostly green and mowed; only minor thin/bare turf patches are visible near the tree line at back-left and around the birdbath post, and a few small weeds are visible among the stepping stones on the right side of the yard.
